The Excise & Taxation Officer, Gurugram had issued a Show Cause Notice to Printing Press (a division of EIH Ltd) for FY 2019-20 under the provisions of Central Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017 in relation to non-payment of GST under RCM on the fees paid to Transport Department of Haryana for preferential registration number/ “Registered Mark of Choice” for a vehicle.
The authorities demanded a sum of Rs 3,600/-, Rs 3,648/- and Rs 3,600/- towards tax, interest and penalty respectively.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Due to non-payment of GST under RCM on the fees paid to Transport Department of Haryana for preferential registration number/ “Registered Mark of Choice” for a vehicle.
